annotations.title: Get a frontier and its current record

description: Frontiers track the best known bound of a quantity (e.g. a kissing number) and who moved it. With an id: the frontier, its current lower and upper records (exact values as strings, never rounded) and its series. Without an id: the list of frontiers with their current records.

id.description: Frontier id, e.g. 'kissing-d11'. Omit to list all frontiers.

lang.description: Language of titles, labels and texts: 'fr' (French) or 'en' (English). Default 'en'. Use the user's language.

name: get_frontier
title: Get a frontier and its current record
